cat >> tests/test_statement.py <<'EOF'


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_stays_one_column():
    import csv
    import io

    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert len(rows[1]) == len(rows[0])
    assert rows[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]


def test_eur_comma_is_still_flattened():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Muller, Schmidt", 100, "a,b", "EUR")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == "eur-1,2024-06-02,Muller  Schmidt,1.00,a b"
EOF
